title: Delegated admin patterns and scope-anchoring for RBAC v2
creator: Maya Patel
description: Proposal and implementation plan for RBAC v2 role model focusing on delegated admin patterns, scope-anchoring, and a compact permissions matrix. Goals: 1) Support delegating administrative responsibilities to tenant-scoped operators without leaking cross-tenant capabilities. 2) Define temporal role bindings (time-limited grants) and context-aware scopes for runtime-elevations used by automation. 3) Provide a migration path from current coarse-grained roles to a combinable primitive model that is easier to audit and reason about. Includes SSO/SAML group-to-role mapping considerations and audit logging hooks for every binding change.
